title: Multi-regime Markov-switching models with time-varying transition probabilities: An application to U.S. Treasury yields
abstract: arXiv:2605.14976v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper studies Markov-switching (MS) models with time-varying transition probabilities (TVTP) under alternative specifications of the transition probability matrix. We extend the two-regime common-variance setting of the Generalized Autoregressive Score (GAS) model of Bazzi et al. (2017) to the general $K$-regime case with regime-specific means and variances, and develop an open-source R package, multiregimeTVTP, for simulation and estimation of such models. A Monte Carlo study shows that the regime means, variances, and transition probabilities are reliably recovered, whereas the TVTP driving coefficients are harder to identify. The GAS score coefficient appears to be statistically non-identifiable, owing to a ridge in the likelihood surface linking it to the regime variance. translated_title: 具有时变转移概率的多区制马尔可夫转换模型：在美国国债收益率中的应用
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在不同转移概率矩阵设定下具有时变转移概率（TVTP）的马尔可夫转换（MS）模型。我们将Bazzi等人（2017）广义自回归得分（GAS）模型的两区制共同方差设定扩展到具有区制特定均值和方差的一般K区制情形，并开发了一个开源R包multiregimeTVTP，用于此类模型的模拟和估计。蒙特卡洛研究表明，区制均值、方差和转移概率能够被可靠地恢复，而TVTP驱动系数则较难识别。GAS得分系数在统计上似乎不可识别，原因是似然面上存在将其与区制方差相关联的脊线。在正确设定下，滤波区制概率能够被准确恢复，而一步前向条件均值则对……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文将带时变转移概率的马尔可夫转换GAS模型从两区制共同方差设定扩展到具有区制特定均值和方差的一般K区制情形，开发了开源R包multiregimeTVTP用于模拟与估计，并通过蒙特卡洛研究发现区制均值、方差和转移概率可被可靠识别，而GAS得分系数因似然面脊线问题在统计上不可识别。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Markov-switching GAS model with time-varying transition probabilities from a two-regime common-variance setting to a general K-regime case with regime-specific means and variances, develops an open-source R package (multiregimeTVTP) for simulation and estimation, and shows via Monte Carlo that regime means, variances, and transition probabilities are reliably identified, while the GAS score coefficient is statistically non-identifiable due to a ridge in the likelihood surface.
